about: Ratchet list for test/registry_schema_parity.mjs. Each entry is a parameter difference between the MCP zod schema and the agent_registry.rs row that exists TODAY. kind=param: side is the copy that HAS the parameter. kind=required: side is the copy that REQUIRES it. kind=type: side is 'both' and detail is 'mcp=<types> backend=<types>'. A difference not listed fails; a listed entry that is no longer a difference fails. Delete lines as the copies are reconciled; never add one without a reason. Measured 2026-11-17: 23 entries across 17 tools (MCP audit 1.10). See roshera-eval/mcp/PARITY_TEST.md.
